# Gelabber v0.10.0

Integrated through #514, #524 to #537 and #539 into `v0.10` and the version
PR into `main`.

Eight work packages that ship together in the server, the web client and
the desktop app: English next to German, roles and channels limited to
roles, a call view that shows who watches a Live, sign-in with Google, an
account page with devices, export, deletion and server transfer, the
directory "Entdecken", an operator area with invitation-only registration,
and public landing and legal pages. There are six database migrations
(`0030` to `0035`); `0031` changes existing rights. `compose.yaml` gains
settings for `api` and `web` and a read-only `./legal` folder. `.env`
needs no edit: Google sign-in, the directory, invitation-only registration
and the public pages stay off until the operator turns them on.

**Back up before the update.** The migrations cannot be undone; the way
back to v0.9.3 is the backup from before it.

## English (#528, #535)

- **Both clients speak German and English**, in the browser and the
  desktop app. Each account chooses under Einstellungen → Darstellung →
  "Sprache"; the change reaches its other devices at once. Push, account
  mail and a new server's default channel names follow it.
- Existing accounts stay German. A new account takes the language it
  registered in, then the browser's, then German. The desktop app, signed
  out, uses its stored language, then the system's, then English. English
  is British English.
- Emoji search works with English names. The only change in German: the
  desktop app groups counts from 1,000 ("3.963 Emojis gefunden"), as the
  web does.

## Roles and channel access (#529, browser and app)

- **Roles** with a name, one of six colours and rights from the fixed
  list; a member can hold several. "Alle Mitglieder" is the base role and
  keeps what the old "Rechte" tab set; the owner holds everything. The tab
  is now "Rollen", and the member list shows role chips and a picker.
- **"Mitglieder moderieren"** is a new right and is now needed for kick,
  ban, the ban list and unban, instead of "Server verwalten".
- **"Zugriff"** in the channel dialogs limits a text channel or voice room
  to chosen roles. Everyone else stops seeing it: sidebar, direct link,
  search, unread, mentions, push and the voice roster. A limited channel
  shows a lock. Whoever loses access while in a voice room of that server
  is taken out of the call.
- There is no rank between roles: anyone with "Server verwalten" can edit
  every role and give themselves any right short of owner.

## Call view (#530, browser and app)

- Without cameras or a Live, two or more people fill the stage with their
  tiles. Someone alone keeps the card.
- **Every Live says who watches it.** In Fokus a tile says "Schaut zu" or
  "Ist live". Whoever is live sees the count on the call bar's Live button,
  with who watches, who does not, and "Live beenden".
- The room's facts ("4 im Kanal · 1 Live"), Raster/Fokus and Kino are in
  the channel header; the stage bar is gone. The call bar loses its gear;
  its connection status opens the details, now with "Lautstärke", and the
  user panel's gear opens the quick call settings.

## Your account (#534, #536, browser and app)

- **"Über Google anmelden"** on sign-in and register, if the operator set
  it up; the app uses the system browser. A Google account joins an
  existing account only if its address is confirmed; otherwise a new
  account is made, without a password until its owner sets one.
- **Einstellungen → Sicherheit:** "Anmeldung" (password, connect or
  disconnect Google; the last way in cannot be removed), "Angemeldete
  Geräte" (sign out any browser or app; "Überall abmelden" moved here),
  the data export and "Konto löschen".
- **Export:** a ZIP with your account data, your own messages, files and
  reactions, downloadable for 7 days by default. The app saves it where
  you choose.
- **Deletion** is final and needs the password (or, without one, the
  address within 10 minutes of signing in). It is refused while you own a
  server; "Server übergeben" in Servereinstellungen → Gefahrenzone hands
  one to another member.

## Entdecken (#533, #537, browser and app)

If the operator turns the directory on, a compass tile opens "Entdecken"
with search and a language filter. Owners list a server under
Servereinstellungen → "Verzeichnis", open or by request; a listing shows
name, image, description, language and member count only. Requests go to
the owner and to "Mitglieder moderieren"; a declined person can ask again
after 7 days. "Melden" sends a report with a copy of the listing to the
operator. People banned from a server do not see its listing, and a
deleted account's requests are withdrawn at once (#537).

## Operator area and registration (#531)

- **"Betrieb"** (`/betrieb`) has beta invitations, accounts, servers,
  reports and usage, in the browser only; the app's user menu opens it in
  the browser. Operators disable accounts ("Dieses Konto ist gesperrt."),
  block servers (members see a notice and can leave), take servers out of
  the directory and close reports. Every action is recorded.
- **Invitation-only registration:** the register page asks for an
  invitation, in the browser and the app. An operator's beta invitation
  works once; an invite link to a server that is not blocked also admits.

## Public pages (#532, #539)

- An optional landing page in English and German and the pages Impressum,
  Datenschutz and Nutzungsbedingungen, without scripts. A page missing a
  required value is not published, and nothing links to it.
- Both clients link the published legal pages under the sign-in card; the
  app opens them in the browser.

## Desktop app (#539, #527)

- Everything above except the operator pages. On purpose unlike the web:
  "Ton mitsenden" is on by default, focus rings are for the keyboard only.
- It bundles its sign-in artwork (the web's WebP) instead of loading it,
  and names itself `Gelabber-Desktop/0.10.0 (linux)` or `(windows)` so the
  device list shows its system.
- A server left before the server list loaded no longer comes back.

## Upgrade notes

- The image pins `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to
  `v0.10.0`. `compose.yaml` changes: bring the checkout to the tag first.
- **Migrations** run at the API's start: `0030` languages (all existing
  accounts German), `0031` roles, `0032` operator tables, `0033` optional
  passwords and Google identities, `0034` session devices, deletion and
  exports, `0035` the directory. **`0031` changes rights:** every server
  whose base role held "Server verwalten" also gets "Mitglieder
  moderieren", so whoever could kick and ban still can. `0032` and `0034`
  each build an index over all messages; the time on a large table was not
  measured. Sessions from before show as an unknown device until renewed.
- **Rollback:** the v0.9.3 image set plus the database and storage backup.
  v0.9.3 does not start on the migrated database.
- **`APP_PUBLIC_URL` is now checked without mail too:** a value that is not
  an http(s) URL, or `http://` with `API_COOKIE_SECURE=true`, stops the
  API. It is now also passed to `web` and used for invitation links.
- **New settings**, optional, each with a section in `deploy/README.md`:
  - `API_OPERATOR_EMAILS`: operators. Empty: no "Betrieb". With mail off,
    whoever registers a listed address first is operator; register first.
  - `API_REGISTRATION`: `open` (default) or `invitation`.
  - `API_DIRECTORY`: `true` turns on "Entdecken". Default `false`.
  - `OIDC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `OIDC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`: both empty, off.
    One alone, or either without `APP_PUBLIC_URL`, stops the API. Redirect
    URI: `APP_PUBLIC_URL/api/auth/oidc/google/callback`; web sign-in works
    only at that address.
  - `API_EXPORT_RETENTION_HOURS` (1 to 720, default 168) and
    `API_EXPORT_MAX_BYTES` (default 10 GiB). The API writes an export to
    its `/tmp` first; leave room on the disk.
  - `GELABBER_LANDING`, `GELABBER_OPERATOR_*`, `GELABBER_*_EMAIL` and the
    others in `.env.example`, plus texts in `deploy/compose/legal/`. All
    empty: `/` goes to sign-in and `robots.txt` disallows everything.
- An invalid `API_*` or `OIDC_*` value stops the API; a malformed
  `GELABBER_*` address or URL is left out with a warning in the log.
  Recreate `api` after an `API_*` or `OIDC_*` change; `docker compose up
  -d web` after a `GELABBER_*` change, `restart web` after editing a text.
- **Order:** the server first, then the apps. A 0.10 app on an older server
  hides "Sprache". 0.9 apps stay German, show as the app without a system,
  and still load the artwork the server keeps for them.
- **Desktop:** Windows offers the update itself; Arch: `pacman -Syu`.

## CI and repository

- libwebrtc packages are fetched only with a listed SHA-256, release
  builds still make a loopback call, Rust tests run on two runners, and the
  image layer cache is in the registry (#511 to #513, #524).
- MIT `LICENSE`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `SECURITY.md` and an English README
  (#525); design references in `docs/design/v0.10/` (#514).

## Open

- Google sign-in ran against a stand-in provider only, never Google.
- The app's new parts ran on Linux; Windows was type-checked only, without
  a real tray or the export's save dialog. Nothing ran on macOS.
- Calls were held with up to 8 people; 25 were laid out in tests. Taking a
  seated member out of a newly limited room is covered by tests only.
- Layout fixes after the last screenshots (roles, operator pages, account)
  were not looked at again; dialogs are tested through their logic, not
  clicks.
- The directory still accepts a disabled account's request or join; only
  accounts under deletion are refused. Left until decided.
- A disabled account signed out first sees "session expired"; a deleted
  member's reactions stay visible until the next refetch; deleted data
  stays in older backups until they rotate out.
- Four German plurals are wrong for exactly one ("1 Emojis gefunden"), as
  before, in both clients.
